description.en: Loads and runs the fixed master-avatar event script (data/script/event/ev42132000.nutb), passing it the given event ID and NPC handle, then drives its Event coroutine to completion frame by frame. Used for NPCs of the "master avatar" event type.
Event ID passed through to the loaded script as subev_ctx.id.
NPC handle passed through to the loaded script as subev_ctx.npc_hdl.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
